## What's new

- **Search in the top bar.** Tapping **Search game**, or pressing **△**, expands that same capsule into the search field and raises the keyboard. The separate field below is gone. Results show underneath as you type. **✕** in the field, or **○**, closes the search.
- **Tab bar back to always visible.** A standard Liquid Glass bar, centred at the bottom, no longer collapses.
  - With a controller connected, **L1 / R1** switch between Home, Library and Settings, and their glyphs show at the ends of the bar.
  - **Options** no longer moves to the tab bar.

## Install
Download `Starlight.ipa` below and install it with [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io) over your current version, using the same Bundle ID.
